sourceFile: 6.1. BRS-161016 GMI Report test TIP 864   date 18.09.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft misidentifies the primary comparison; the report compares TIP 864 against normal TIP 844, not before-repair versus after-repair status.
issues: Changed factor should be TIP 864 vs TIP 844 normal.
Vision judgement incorrectly treats repair as improvement.
Baseline/test conditions mix repair state, voltage, and tip type.
Measurement outcome from defect columns is not a valid measurement domain.
Conclusion rows indicate vision worse for TIP 864 and function similar.
correctionPlan: Set primary changed factor to TIP 864 versus TIP 844 normal.
Keep repair state and voltage as subgroup/context keys.
Rebuild vision outcome comparing TIP 864 totals to TIP 844 normal totals.
Set function outcome as similar/no meaningful difference using TIP 864 and TIP 844 rows.
Remove bogus measurement outcome or recast defect-type counts under process defect.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are citeable but grouping is insufficient; include purpose, normal TIP 844, result rows, and conclusion rows.
